name: Treatment Of Spouse
overview: Scripture reveals that the treatment of one's spouse is rooted in God's design for marriage as a sacred union where a man and woman become one flesh (Genesis 2:24; Matthew 19:4). Finding a wife is described as receiving a blessing and favor from the Lord (Proverbs 18:22), highlighting the value God places on this relationship. Believers are called to embody kindness, tenderheartedness, and forgiveness toward one another, reflecting God's grace through Christ (Ephesians 4:32). Within this covenant, wives are instructed to submit to their husbands as to the Lord (Ephesians 5:22), underscoring a God-ordained order that honors Him in the marital relationship.
